uncertain_points.claim: State encoding uses arbitrary 8-bit values that may be vulnerable to silent corruption by single-bit flips, as any bit flip could transition to another valid state without detection.
uncertain_points.cond: EnableIntg is true and integrity handling state machine is active.
uncertain_points.risk: A soft error in the state register could cause the state machine to jump to an unintended valid state, potentially allowing integrity bypass, data corruption, or security violation.

formal_sketch.antecedent: EnableIntg is true and integrity handling state machine is active
formal_sketch.consequent: State encoding uses arbitrary 8-bit values that may be vulnerable to silent corruption by single-bit flips, as any bit flip could transition to another valid state without detection
